note: retrievalStatus separates DISCOVERY from RETRIEVAL. Only entries marked retrieved-validated or verified-against-original contributed data to any export. Entries marked discovered or not-attempted are documented leads, and nothing depends on them.

entries.title: Monthly Prescription Drug Plan Formulary and Pharmacy Network Information
entries.populationCovered: All Medicare Part D and MA-PD enrollees nationwide
entries.geography: United States, all states and territories
entries.accessNotes: No key, no registration. The host supports HTTP range requests (Accept-Ranges: bytes, verified HTTP 206), which is how only the needed members are fetched.
entries.format: ZIP of ZIPs containing pipe-delimited text with header rows
entries.licensing: Public domain (US Government work). Redistribution permitted.
knownGaps: Tier NUMBERS only; the plan-defined MEANING of a tier is not in this dataset.
No preferred/non-preferred pharmacy designation in the basic drugs file.
No indication-specific criteria in the basic drugs file (a separate indication-based coverage file exists and is ~0 MB in this release).
Beneficiary cost file gives plan RULES by tier, never a member's actual cost.
Pharmacy network files are 2.18 GB of the 2.14 GB archive and are deliberately not fetched.
entries.approximateSize: Archive 2.14 GB; only ~8.8 MB fetched (basic drugs formulary 7.9 MB, plan information 0.4 MB, beneficiary cost 0.4 MB, excluded drugs ~0 MB)
entries.verificationNotes: 979 formulary rows and 5,517 plans retained after filtering to our products' RXCUIs. Individual rows were checked against the original file: Ozempic RXCUI 2398842 on formulary 00026000 is tier 3, PRIOR_AUTHORIZATION_YN=Y, QUANTITY_LIMIT 3 per 28 days, which matches the exported evidence exactly.

entries.title: Quarterly Prescription Drug Plan Formulary, Pharmacy Network, and Pricing Information
entries.accessNotes: Public. Adds negotiated PRICING files the monthly release does not carry.
knownGaps: Pricing here is plan-level negotiated pricing, not an individual's out-of-pocket cost.
entries.approximateSize: Not measured; the monthly release already provides formulary and UM data.
entries.verificationNotes: Located in the CMS catalogue and confirmed reachable. NOT ingested: the monthly release covers formulary membership and utilisation management, which is what the exports need. Worth adding if plan-level pricing becomes a requirement.

entries.title: Health Insurance Exchange Public Use Files (Plan Attributes, Benefits and Cost Sharing)
entries.populationCovered: QHP enrollees in states using the federal platform
entries.geography: FFE/SBE-FP states. State-based exchanges publish separately.
entries.accessNotes: Published as CSV bundles on the CMS Marketplace PUF page.
knownGaps: Plan Attributes and Benefits/Cost-Sharing PUFs describe BENEFIT DESIGN, not a drug-level formulary.
Drug-level formularies are published by each ISSUER via machine-readable URLs, not by CMS centrally.
State-based exchanges (including several large states) are not in the federal files.
A HIOS plan id has cost-sharing VARIANTS; the variant materially changes cost sharing.
entries.verificationNotes: NOT ingested. Establishing an exact drug-level Marketplace formulary requires the issuer's own machine-readable formulary URL plus a documented plan-to-formulary mapping. Without that mapping the applicability would be unresolved, which is worse than absent. Documented rather than guessed.

entries.owner: Virginia Department of Medical Assistance Services
entries.title: Virginia Medicaid Preferred Drug List and Common Core Formulary
entries.accessNotes: Published as PDFs on the DMAS pharmacy pages.
knownGaps: PDF tables need extraction with header and footnote preservation; footnotes carry the criteria.
Fee-for-service and MCO coverage differ; each MCO may apply its own rules on top of the common core.
entries.verificationNotes: NOT ingested. Virginia was the chosen demo jurisdiction, but a PDL PDF requires table extraction with footnote preservation and manual row-by-row verification before any restriction could be exported. Quarantining an uncertain extraction is required by the brief, so it is registered as discovered rather than parsed badly.

entries.title: Commercial plan and PBM formularies
entries.accessNotes: Issuer-published formulary documents and Transparency in Coverage machine-readable files.
entries.licensing: Varies by issuer; redistribution is often restricted.
knownGaps: A PBM's standard formulary is NOT proof that a given employer plan uses it. Employer plans routinely apply custom formularies and exclusions.
Transparency in Coverage in-network files are frequently multi-gigabyte and are oriented to negotiated RATES, not drug-level formulary membership.
No public, authoritative employer-plan-to-formulary crosswalk exists.
entries.approximateSize: Transparency files routinely exceed 1 GB per issuer
entries.verificationNotes: Deliberately not ingested. Without a documented plan-to-formulary mapping, any commercial result would have to be classified as unresolved applicability, and downloading multi-gigabyte rate files that do not carry drug-level formulary membership is exactly the indiscriminate transfer the brief rules out.

entries.title: Medicare Part D Extra Help (Low-Income Subsidy)
entries.populationCovered: Medicare beneficiaries meeting income and resource limits
entries.accessNotes: Official SSA program page; eligibility limits published annually.
knownGaps: Eligibility depends on income and resources that this pipeline neither has nor should have.
entries.verificationNotes: Registered as an official next-step destination only. This pipeline must never assert that a person qualifies, and assistance is not insurance coverage.

entries.title: Real-Time Prescription Benefit and electronic benefit verification
entries.populationCovered: Individual members, at the point of prescribing
entries.accessNotes: Requires a trading-partner agreement, credentials, and patient identifiers. Standards documents themselves are licensed by NCPDP.
knownGaps: Needs member identifiers, which this pipeline deliberately never handles.
No public API exists. Nothing here simulates one.
entries.verificationNotes: This is the ONLY route to a genuine member-specific benefit answer. It requires contracts, credentials and patient information, so it is documented as a boundary rather than implemented. No pretend live connection exists anywhere in this codebase.
